gateWhy: app/api/projects/[id]/export/route.ts, lib/zip.ts and the Download .zip button in app/projects/[id]/Editor.tsx are all UNTRACKED in git — built, not deployed. Every sentence below is TRUE in production right now. Applying these before the deploy replaces a true statement with a false one; applying them long after leaves 30+ live pages telling people a shipped feature does not exist. There is no safe ordering other than the same window.
why: Inverts the "there is no zip or full-project download" claim across every live post, for the deploy that ships the export route. Ground truth after the deploy: the editor has a Download .zip button that calls GET /api/projects/[id]/export, which streams the draft source tree (kind: "source") nested under one folder named for the project slug. It is the source project, not the compiled build output, and there is still no GitHub sync — replacements must not promise either.
